title: French Beef Soufflé
description: A classic French dish with a tender beef cutlet and a rich soufflé topping.
instructions: Season the beef cutlets with salt and pepper.
Dredge the beef cutlets in flour.
Melt 1 tablespoon of butter in a pan over medium heat.
Sear the beef cutlets until browned, then set aside.
Melt the remaining 1 tablespoon of butter in the pan.
Add the onion and garlic, cooking until softened.
Add the milk, whisking until combined.
Bring the mixture to a simmer and cook until thickened.
In a separate bowl, whisk together the eggs and Gruyère cheese.
Pour the egg mixture over the beef cutlets and onion mixture.
Transfer the mixture to a baking dish and bake for 20-25 minutes, or until puffed and golden.
